question: Which of the following names corresponds to that of a series of the emission spectrum of the hydrogen atom ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Balmer -> Emission spectrum of hydrogen atom -> 95% CHAIN: Balmer -> Visible light spectrum -> 85% CHAIN: Balmer -> Series of spectral lines in the visible region -> 95%
analysis: The series of the emission spectrum of the hydrogen atom that corresponds to a specific set of spectral lines in the visible region is known as the Balmer series.
